in_tamil.long_meaning: Nirbāy - அதிக்கப்பட்ட போதுவாளர் (One who is beyond fear) Rājā - ராஜா (Ruler)

in_marathi.name: Nirbhayraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirbhayraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nirbhayraj is a compound name derived from 'Nirbhay' and 'Raj'. 'Nirbhay' means fearless or fearless one, while 'Raj' means king or ruler. Thus, Nirbhayraj translates to 'Fearless Ruler'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, where gods and heroes are often depicted as fearless protectors and rulers.
